pages.seoDescription: Ironwood Tattoo is a private, dark studio for custom blackwork, fine-line, traditional and realism. Book a free consultation with your artist online.

children.class: relative mx-auto flex min-h-96 w-full max-w-5xl flex-col justify-center gap-6 px-6 py-28 text-white @3xl:py-40 items-center text-center

children: A dark studio for considered, hand-drawn tattoos — blackwork, fine-line, traditional and realism. Every piece starts as a conversation, never a flash sheet.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Nothing here is copy-and-paste. Your artist draws the piece for you, for your body, and refines it with you before a needle touches skin.
Big or small, every tattoo begins with a free sit-down. We plan placement, size and price up front, so the day of is calm and certain.
Single-use needles, hospital-grade sterilisation and licensed artists. The craft is loud; the hygiene is quiet and non-negotiable.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Sessions are priced by the time your piece takes. Consultations are free — start there, and we’ll size the rest together. Live availability is on the booking page.

children: A room built for the work
Ironwood is a private, low-lit studio — three chairs, no walk-in churn, no music you have to shout over. Just focused artists and the time a good tattoo actually needs.
We’d rather do fewer pieces properly than rush a room full. That is the whole idea: craft over comfort, and ink you’ll still be glad you got in twenty years.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Ironwood Tattoo is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A dimly lit tattoo studio with a single artist at work

children: We opened Ironwood to tattoo the way we always wanted to be tattooed — slowly, custom, and by the same artist from the first sketch to the last line.
No flash-sheet churn, no rush, no leaving with something you settled for. Just hand-drawn work, an honest plan, and a studio that takes hygiene as seriously as the art.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every piece starts with a free sit-down about your idea, your body and your budget — before we book anything.
A deposit that holds your chair
Sessions carry a $50 deposit that comes off your total and reserves the artist’s time. Reschedule with 72 hours’ notice and it carries over.
We tattoo to last and send you home knowing exactly how to heal it — so the piece looks as good on year ten as on day one.
